children: Interparfums announced an exclusive worldwide license with Puma to create, produce and distribute Puma fragrances through Dec. 31, 2037.
Entered exclusive, worldwide license with Puma for creation, development, production and distribution of Puma fragrances.
License term runs through December 31, 2037, with new signature lifestyle fragrance planned for 2027.
Deal expands Interparfums' licensed portfolio and leverages Puma's global brand and cultural reach to drive consumer engagement.
